# `kll_merge_agg_bigint`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
kll_merge_agg_bigint(expr[, k])
```

Merges binary KllLongsSketch representations and returns the merged sketch.
The input expression should contain binary sketch representations (e.g., from kll_sketch_agg_bigint).
The optional k parameter controls the size and accuracy of the merged sketch (range 8-65535).
If k is not specified, the merged sketch adopts the k value from the first input sketch.

## Examples

```sql
-- kll_merge_agg_bigint, example 1
> SELECT kll_sketch_get_n_bigint(kll_merge_agg_bigint(sketch)) FROM (SELECT kll_sketch_agg_bigint(col) as sketch FROM VALUES (1), (2), (3) tab(col) UNION ALL SELECT kll_sketch_agg_bigint(col) as sketch FROM VALUES (4), (5), (6) tab(col)) t;
```
